topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't believe this. Out of all the teachers at this school, my child gets the one I had. The same one who couldn’t even keep a class under control, let alone teach anything useful. I remember sitting through those classes, watching the clock, and thinking, what a waste. Now my kid has to suffer through the same? I’m not having it. This is not what I hoped for when I moved into this district for the schools. I’m setting up a meeting with the principal. This needs to be fixed, and it needs to be now.
